title: Web console: ID list formatter for issue IDs (front-end)
description:
The web console (React app in apps/console) needs a front-end equivalent of the CLI's ID list formatter: a shared utility that takes a list of raw issue IDs and formats them safely for display.

Behavior:
- Trim each ID's hash to as few characters as possible (default 4).
- Lowercase the displayed ID.
- Within the visible set, iteratively widen only the colliding groups until every displayed ID in that list is unique. No upper cap.
- Re-run whenever the visible set changes (filters, search, expanding or collapsing columns, trees, or children).
- Full IDs are always kept underneath for links, lookups, and copy actions.

Integration:
- Any component that shows more than one issue ID at once (board cards, lists, trees, dependency and child views, panels) must route through the ID list formatter.
- Prefer a hook at the data layer (for example, a hook that derives display keys from the currently visible issues) so individual components don't have to remember to call it.
- Replace the current fixed 6-character truncation (formatIssueId) for multi-ID views.

Scope: web front-end only. This is separate from the CLI-side dynamic short ID work in epic kbs-429fa3; use the same name and semantics (ID list formatter) so both sides stay consistent.
